objective: Aislar el rc=2 restante del resync de pagos 130QRO verificando el system_type canonico de la unidad/servidor y la relación de servicio/pagos con el esquema vigente. Solo lectura, sin Produccion.

queries.name: 130qro_runtime_mapping_types
queries.sql: SELECT u.codigo,u.nombre,u.id AS unidad_pk,u.server_id,u.sucursal_origen_id,u.system_type AS unidad_system_type,s.system_type AS servidor_system_type,s.database_name,s.activo AS servidor_activo FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u LEFT JOIN dbo.Servidores_Conexiones s ON s.id=u.server_id WHERE UPPER(u.codigo)='130QRO'

queries.name: mpro_service_join_comparison
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda c WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Folio AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal=v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal WHERE v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0021' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)>='2026-08-01' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)<'2026-09-01') AS servicio_por_vnfolio,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda c WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal=v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal WHERE v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0021' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)>='2026-08-01' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)<'2026-09-01') AS servicio_por_vndocumento

queries.name: mpro_exact_payment_extract_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pagos,COUNT(DISTINCT v.Vn_Folio) AS tickets,CAST(SUM(cp.Cp_Importe) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe,CAST(SUM(cp.Cp_Propina) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento LEFT JOIN Forma_Pago fp WITH (NOLOCK) ON fp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago=cp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago WHERE CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)>='2026-08-01' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)<'2026-09-01' AND v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0021' AND ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado,'')<>'CA' AND cp.Cp_Importe>0
